sv.title: ”Extraval inte osannolikt”
sv.summary: Synen på SD tycks ha skurit Centerpartiets riksdagsgrupp mitt itu, tycker statsvetaren Tommy Möller.

en.title: ”Snap election not unlikely”
en.summary: The view of the Sweden Democrats appears to have split the Centre Party's parliamentary group down the middle, says political scientist Tommy Möller.
